'''Dragonsnakes''' were long ferocious creatures native to the swamps of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Dragonsnake_TofG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A dragon snake chasing an [[ASN courier droid/Legends|ASN courier droid]]]]
Dragonsnakes were well-armored super predators<ref name="TWSWFG" /> with razor-sharp fins,<ref name=":3">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Dragonsnake}}</ref> and had rows of sharp fangs in their mouths. They used their propulsive lower tails<ref name="TWSWFG" /> to propel them through their watery habitat; their long arms were mostly used for digging or grasping. In mass, they could be up to 50,000 kilograms. The dragonsnake was a patient predator, usually lying in wait under the water until its prey wandered too close to the water's edge. Lashing out with fins and fangs, the dragonsnake would drag its victim underwater, coiled in its body, until it drowned.

Dragonsnakes were occasionally seen warming themselves on exposed rocks.<ref name="TWSWFG" />

Only a few fellow Dagobah creatures posed a threat to dragonsnakes, as their scales were durable enough to withstand most melee and [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]], and even small arms fire. Dragonsnakes were known to fight the monstrous [[Swamp slug/Legends|swamp slugs]], with which they were often mistaken due the sizes.<ref name=":3" /> Even if devoured by the giant beasts, dragonsnakes could gnaw through the swamp slug's stomach and burst out of its belly. Dragonsnakes rarely mated more often than once every ten standard years, with females laying one to six eggs. These were buried and abandoned, usually resulting in consumption by predators. Hatchlings achieved full size within months and were soon adults.

A breed of dragonsnake that resided on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] differed greatly in its physiology, notably lacking arms and long external ears. Their body was covered in bioluminescent nodules,<ref name=":0" /> giving them a similar appearance to the [[Colo claw fish/Legends|Colo claw fish]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Visitors traversed the bogs on [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Fanboat/Legends|fanboats]], risking the attention of dragonsnakes.<ref name="SWE-Nal Hutta">{{SWE|locations|nalhutta|Nal Hutta}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Dragonsnake-HFZ.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A dragonsnake on Nal Hutta attacks Obi-Wan Kenobi]]
At some point, [[Garnac's hunting guild/Legends|Garnac's hunting guild]] killed a dragonsnake and placed its head in their [[Ubrikkian Floating Fortress]], alongside the trophies made of other [[Species/Legends|creatures]].<ref name="Wookiee Hunt">{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], while [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] searched for [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] on Nal Hutta, an individual of the planet's variety of dragonsnake attacked Obi-Wan. It was killed when the Jedi impaled it through the head with his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref>

The dragonsnakes living in the [[Dragonsnake Bog/Legends|Dragonsnake Bog]] near [[Yoda's Hut/Legends|Yoda's hut]] were oppressed by the [[King of the Dragonsnakes]], a large individual male specimen that dominated the swamp, and they suffered due to his greed.<ref name=":1">''[[Star Wars Adventures: Luke Skywalker and the Treasure of the Dragonsnakes]]''</ref> When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] arrived on Dagobah<ref name=":2">{{Film|V}}</ref> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the King of the Dragonsnakes swallowed his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], but then spit the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] back out after realizing that he was indigestible.<ref name=":2" /> After that, he waited for the opportunity to strike at Skywalker himself. When the opportunity presented itself several days later, the King of the Dragonsnakes found out that his prey was armed with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and Skywalker managed to harm the King and escape. The other Dragonsnakes saw the King's failure as a sign of weakness. Humbled, the King retreated to his [[Lair of the King of the Dragonsnakes|Lair]]. Skywalker, accompanied by [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], followed him there and confronted the King in his very own lair. Using his knowledge of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], he subdued the King to his will and retrieved his prize&mdash;an egg of an [[Accipiptero/Legends|Accipiptero]]. Afterwards, the other Dragonsnakes were no longer afraid of the King, and the swamp returned to balance.<ref name=":1" />

==Behind the scenes==

The Dragonsnake first appeared in the novelization of ''The Empire Strikes Back''.<ref>[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'']] novelization</ref> It then appeared in the film, where its fin was briefly shown.<ref name=":2">{{Film|V}}</ref> The shots of the Dragonsnake used in the film were pick-up shots which were filmed in George Lucas's swimming pool.<ref>''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>
